name: cyber-defense
description: Defensive security work for code and systems you own, and for open-source code with private disclosure to its owner: a scope check before any active probe of a live host, a protocol for model cyber refusals, incident response, static malware triage, YARA/Sigma/semgrep rules with positive and negative controls, CVE triage, PoC confirmation, a sweep of your repositories for leaked secrets and vulnerable dependencies, and a pipeline for finding vulnerabilities in open source (method ladder, container PoCs, a refuter agent, and a report gate that stays closed until the finding carries the owner's label). Ships four subagents: oss-hunter, oss-cartographer, oss-poc-writer, oss-refuter.
